description: This file defines a Router class for handling server-side routing in a Next.js application, including route matching, middleware execution, and route configuration.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: A class managing server-side route matching, including handling of static, dynamic, rewrite, redirect, and fallback routes, with support for locale and base path normalization.

methods.name: setDynamicRoutes
methods.description: Sets the dynamic routes for the router instance.

methods.name: addFsRoute
methods.description: Adds a new filesystem route to the beginning of the fsRoutes array.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes route matching and handling logic for incoming requests, including filesystem, page, rewrite, redirect, and fallback routes.
